seoTitle: Fix "No Comments Yet" on Instagram Despite Comments
metaDescription: Fix Instagram showing "No comments yet" even though people have commented, by clearing cache, checking filters, and updating the app.
intro: Seeing a comment count on a post but an empty comment section underneath is a frustrating display bug that stops you from engaging with your audience. This guide covers the most common fixes, from clearing cached data to checking your comment filter settings.

steps.heading: Identify the missing comment error
steps.body: Confirm the post shows a comment count but the section itself appears empty or stuck on "No comments yet."

steps.heading: Clear Instagram app cache and data
steps.body: Go to your phone's app settings, find Instagram, and clear its cache to remove corrupted files causing the display issue.

steps.heading: Check hidden words and filter settings
steps.body: Review your comment control and hidden words settings, since automated filters can sometimes hide legitimate comments from view.

steps.heading: Update the app
steps.body: Make sure Instagram is updated to the latest version, since bugs like this are often addressed in app updates.

steps.heading: Refresh and verify
steps.body: Reload the post or restart the app to force a manual refresh, then check whether the comments reappear.

faq.question: Why does Instagram show a comment count but no comments?
faq.answer: This is usually caused by corrupted cache files, a temporary server sync error, or comment filter settings hiding legitimate comments.

faq.question: Could my filter settings be hiding real comments?
faq.answer: Yes, hidden words or automated comment filters can sometimes hide comments that should be visible, so it's worth reviewing those settings.

faq.question: Will clearing my cache delete my comments?
faq.answer: No, clearing the app cache only removes temporary files and doesn't delete your comments or posts.

faq.question: Is this a widespread bug or specific to my account?
faq.answer: It can affect many users due to server sync issues, but checking your own filter settings and app version is still worth doing first.
